# EOHHS Commonwealth Resident Index (MDM demo)

Entity resolution proof of concept for Massachusetts EOHHS. Four agencies (MassHealth, DTA, BSAS, EHS) each resolve their own records, then roll up to a hub that links residents across agencies and writes an EOHHS ID back to each agency.

**All data is synthetic.** Names, SSNs and addresses are generated by `generate_data.py`. No real PII.

## What it builds

| Database | Role |
|---|---|
| MASSHEALTH, DTA, BSAS, EHS | Agency pipelines: RAW_BRONZE, INTEGRATION_SILVER, MASTER_GOLD, GOV, APP |
| EOHHS_HUB | Cross-agency hub. Reads each agency's `MASTER_GOLD.HUB_EXPORT`, writes `EOHHS_ID_MAP` back |

Matching tiers: Tier 1 rules (S0 to S5, plus S6 token match at the hub), Tier 2 ML (scikit-learn in a stored procedure), Tier 3 Cortex AI_COMPLETE, then a steward review queue. Every database is scored against ground truth in `GOV.MATCH_QUALITY_SCORECARD`.

BSAS sends the hub salted tokens only (42 CFR Part 2). Other agencies never see BSAS in `LINKED_AGENCIES`.

Two apps from one codebase (`app/`): the hub Resident Index and the MassHealth Member Index. `lib/deployment.ts` switches between them; `deploy.sh` sets it.

## Prerequisites

- Snowflake CLI (`snow`) with a named connection
- Role SYSADMIN (or equivalent: create databases, procedures, application services)
- Warehouse `EOHHS_WH`: created automatically by `run_pipeline.sh` if it does not exist (Medium, auto-suspend 60s)
- Cortex `AI_COMPLETE` with `claude-sonnet-4-5` available in your region (or cross-region inference enabled)
- Snowflake App Runtime enabled in the account
- Python 3.10+ (standard library only), Node 20+

## Build

```bash
export SNOWFLAKE_CONNECTION=<your connection name>

./run_pipeline.sh          # generate data, build 4 agencies in parallel, then the hub, then grants and scorecards
./deploy.sh hub            # deploy the apps one at a time, never in parallel
./deploy.sh masshealth
```

Both scripts also take the connection as an argument: `./run_pipeline.sh myconn`, `./deploy.sh hub myconn`.

Rerun `sql/app_grants.sql` after any pipeline rebuild.

## Before a demo

```sql
CALL EOHHS_HUB.MASTER_GOLD.RESET_STEWARD_DEMO();
CALL MASSHEALTH.MASTER_GOLD.RESET_STEWARD_DEMO();
```

Then open both apps once so they are warm.

## Files

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `generate_data.py` | Synthetic source data and ground truth, written to `data/` |
| `render.py`, `sql/template.sql` | One SQL template rendered per database into `sql/build/` |
| `sql/app_grants.sql` | Caller grants for the apps |
| `run_pipeline.sh`, `deploy.sh` | Build and deploy |
| `app/` | Next.js app (both deployments) |
| `demo_script.md` | Demo flow with live numbers |
| `demo_follow_one_person.sql` | Worksheet: follow Ana Oliveira from bronze to the hub |
| `diagram/` | Generators for the Lucid diagrams |

## Troubleshooting

- **MassHealth app shows the hub:** a deploy failed partway. Redeploy `./deploy.sh masshealth` alone.
- **Record pages error but aggregate pages work:** rerun `sql/app_grants.sql`.
- **Build failure:** see `logs/<DB>.log`, or the build log query printed by `snow app deploy`.
